column6: A URL, tagged release, or demo video is provided (link the CI run when one exists); or the note says plainly that nothing works yet and why. Where a video replaces a student's part of the check-in (they missed it, or the TA could not meet), it is on media.oregonstate.edu, unlisted, captioned, with one timestamp per student.
column9: Item missing: no evidence and no plain statement of why nothing works yet.

column6: Two lists, each entry as a table row or under its own subheading; one student can own several entries. Done: work completed this sprint, each entry with what now exists, linked to its proof of completion (the pull request approved and merged, the issue or ticket closed with its outcome, or the document reviewed and approved, a partner's review or approval included); its owner; and who reviewed and accepted it. Code meets the team's Definition of Done. In progress, optional: anything else the team has started and taken far along, linked to where it is written up, with its owner and its current status (in review, or how far along it is). Work finished in an earlier sprint and routine upkeep (a formatter run, a lockfile bump, a rename, or a ticket moved on the board) are on neither list. Non-code work counts. Where a grader cannot open the work (an NDA, or a partner's own system), the entry describes it in place of the link, with partner specifics replaced by neutral placeholders, and the team shows the TA the work itself on a shared screen at the check-in.
column9: Item missing: no Done entries; an entry has no owner, or neither a link nor, where the work cannot be opened, a description; a Done entry has no reviewer, was not completed this sprint, or, for code, misses the team's Definition of Done; an In progress entry gives no status; an entry was finished in an earlier sprint or is routine upkeep; or an entry describes how time was spent ("worked on the API") rather than what now exists or is being built.

column6: Every student owns at least one entry on either list or is named on the closing line as owning nothing this sprint. Each student who owns a Done entry marks their most consequential one, which carries their human-written sentence on how the team checked it: for code, the test or the run; for research, a decision, or a document, what it was checked against and who confirmed it. A review that took judgment, on either list, names in its reviewer note the change asked for or what was checked, and where an AI reviewer ran, what the reviewer checked that the tool could not; a routine approval needs only the reviewer's name. Graders open one owned entry per student.
column9: Item missing: a student who owns no entry and is not named on the closing line; a student who owns a Done entry and marked none, or whose marked entry has no sentence; a reviewer note that names neither a change nor a check; or the entry a grader opens does not show its owner authored or drove it.

column6: Names the risk ranked first in docs/risks.md, linked at the sprint's last commit, however small it is, and one decision the team needs, linked to the artifact where it is being made, naming who makes it, or says plainly that no decision is needed this sprint. Reports the previous note's decision: what was decided and who chaired it, or that it is still open and why.
column9: Item missing: no linked risk; neither a decision named with who makes it nor a plain statement that none is needed; or no word on the previous note's decision, where it named one.

column6: About five human-written lines on what the team learned this sprint, naming at least one change to the plan it caused, with its link (a re-scoped story, a re-ranked risk, a revised estimate), or saying plainly that the plan holds and why.
column9: Item missing: absent, reused from an earlier note, or a recap of the work with no change named and no reason the plan holds.
